full_judgment: 12. Lastly, he submits that as per case of the pre-emptor that on taking certified copy of the impugned kabala No. 617 dated 18.02.88 on 16.03.88 he filed the application on 25.09.88, the application for pre-emption is on the face of it is beyond four months and ought to have been held to be barred by limitation and in support of his submission, he cited the decision reported in 4 BLD (AD) 32. He also cited the decision reported in 33 DLR 318 on subdivision of a holding and distribution of rent. Finally, he submits that the judgment and order of the appellate court below are not proper judgment of reversal and, therefore, are liable to be set aside.
